name: LawsonEuler
order_framework: Lawson/integrating-factor; not certified via OTW P,Q
provenance: Lawson transformation + forward Euler; EXPINT documentation.

name: NorsettEuler
provenance: Standard variation-of-constants exponential Euler; EXPINT documentation. Nørsett 1969 not required.

name: ETD2RK
audit_note: The supplied 2005 etd2rk.m uses b1=phi1-2phi2. Published formula and README require b1=phi1-phi2. The legacy line fails first-order consistency at L=0.

name: ETD4RK
order_framework: Hochbruck-Ostermann stiff ExpRK conditions; P,Q alone are not sufficient
provenance: Cox & Matthews (2002), Eqs. (26)-(29); stiff-order analysis Hochbruck & Ostermann (2005).

name: Krogstad
order_framework: Hochbruck-Ostermann stiff ExpRK conditions; P,Q alone are not sufficient

name: ABNorsett4
provenance: Ostermann-Thalhammer-Wright (2006) EGLM414; matches EXPINT ABNorsett4 coefficients.

name: PEC423
audit_note: EXPINT README prose saying stiff order 3 is erroneous.

name: PECEC433
order_framework: OTW 2006 conditions applied symbolically to documented coefficients
provenance: EXPINT published documentation; verified independently against OTW order conditions.
audit_note: EXPINT README prose saying stiff order 3 is erroneous.

name: EGLM332
provenance: EXPINT published documentation; independently verified with OTW conditions.
audit_note: Legacy MATLAB header 'Order 4, s=2, r=3' is wrong; actual mathematical signature is p=3,s=3,q=2.

name: EGLM433
provenance: EXPINT published documentation; independently verified with OTW conditions.
audit_note: Distinct from the EGLM432 printed in BIT 2006. Its quadrature order is actually 5.

name: GenLawson43
provenance: Krogstad generalized-IF construction + EXPINT published coefficients. Order signature exactly matches BIT's GLRK34.
audit_note: Strong P=3; fourth order comes from weak quadrature condition P=4.

name: ModGenLawson43
order_framework: OTW 2006 Theorem 3.4 applied to documented modified output
provenance: EXPINT published documentation. Specific Thalhammer-Wright manuscript appears not to have reached identifiable publication.
audit_note: Same A,U,c as GenLawson43, but modified B,V upgrade quadrature from weak order 4 to strong P=4.
